philosophy: Build with clarity, truth, and foresight. Create systems that are not just scalable in performance, but also in human understanding.

principles.name: Clarity Above All
principles.description: The interface must be unambiguous, presenting information and actions with absolute clarity to eliminate cognitive load.

principles.name: Structure as a Guide
principles.description: Visual hierarchy is a map that guides the user through complexity, making the powerful feel simple.

principles.name: Truth in Data
principles.description: Visualizations, metrics, and all data displays must be honest, precise, and easy to interpret.

principles.name: Intentional Interaction
principles.description: Every interactive element exists for a reason. Its behavior and the system's response must be predictable, reliable, and consistent.

principles.name: Systematic & Scalable
principles.description: Components are designed as part of a larger system to be composed, reused, and adapted, ensuring design integrity at scale.

source.reset: styles/reset.css (replaces Tailwind preflight: no Tailwind on this site)
source.bundle: src/assets.ts (concatenated in that order, served at /assets/site.<hash>.css)
source.origin: PR #5 (design/jrcodex-2026, SageScale v2), re-branded for juanramirez.codes in spec 003

colors.note: The palette is fixed. Derived tints are computed from it with color-mix(in oklch, …) and have pre-computed static fallbacks.

sage-blue-900.usage: Primary background, dark mode surfaces. Represents the deep unknown.

arcane-gold-500.usage: Primary CTAs, active states, focus indicators, key highlights. The spark of power and insight.

ink-900.usage: Dark surfaces, text on light backgrounds.

parchment-100.usage: Pure white for maximum contrast on dark surfaces.

success-500.usage: Success states, confirmation messages, positive validation.

warning-500.usage: Warnings, non-blocking issues, items needing attention.

error-500.usage: Errors, destructive actions, critical alerts, negative validation.

semantic.note: Components use these, never palette names. Dark is the default scheme; light is an explicit choice stored as <html data-theme="light">.

--text-subtle.usage: Labels and captions on the page surface only. Raised components re-point it to --text-muted.

--accent-text.usage: Gold-as-text in dark; gold is never text on light surfaces.

typography.loading: Both families are self-hosted woff2 (latin subset), preloaded. Inter swaps onto a metric-matched Arial fallback (size-adjust 107.12%, ascent 90.44%, descent 22.52%); Source Serif 4 uses font-display: optional, so a late font never moves a heading. No external stylesheet.

scale.method: Fluid modular scale: base 16px at 320px → 18px at 1280px; ratio 1.2 (minor third) → 1.25 (major third). Each step is clamp(min, intercept + slope·vw, max).
scale.wrapping: Headings use text-wrap: balance; paragraphs, list items and captions use text-wrap: pretty.

spacing.method: Same fluid base (16px → 20px between 320px and 1280px) times a ladder of 0.25 · 0.5 · 0.75 · 1 · 1.5 · 2 · 3 · 4 · 6 · 8.
spacing.utilities: none: compose the primitives; there is no Tailwind on this site

layout.gutter: --gutter: clamp(1rem, 0.5rem + 2.5vw, 2rem) — never below 16px; no horizontal scroll at 320px.
layout.articleGrid: Prose: named tracks full / wide / content (measure). Block placements: content (default), wide, full, inset-right, inset-left.
layout.cardGrid: auto-fill columns from 18rem; container query switches to a horizontal card in a wide single column; subgrid aligns title/description/footer rows across a row.

motion.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce sets every duration to 0ms, stops all animation, turns off smooth scrolling, disables view-transition animation and skips JS-started transitions.

elevation.note: Shadows are tinted with sage-blue-900 so they read in both schemes.

focus.note: Every interactive element gets :focus-visible. Cards ring when their title link is focused.

iconography.style: Minimalist, sharp, line-based icons that feel like precise technical drawings or arcane symbols.
iconography.color: Inherits the color of its parent text element by default.

Button.note: 44px minimum target. ButtonLink uses view-transition navigation for internal hrefs.

CardGrid.note: Stretched-link card; one link per card; secondary links in the footer.

TagChip.note: TagList collapses overflow into a +N chip.

MediaFrame.note: Fixed aspect ratio (no CLS), optional caption and zoom button.

VideoEmbed.note: Lazy iframe in a MediaFrame; title is required.

Prose.note: Article layout for filtered HTML and block placements.

Pagination.note: nav landmark, aria-current, windowed page list.

LoadingState.note: Skeletons reserve the final size; aria-hidden; announce with aria-busy on the region.

Dialog.note: Native <dialog> with showModal(): top layer, focus trap, Esc. closedby="any" plus a backdrop-click fallback.

Tooltip.note: popover="manual" + anchor positioning; a hint only, never the sole label.

ThemeToggle.note: Dark default; light persisted in localStorage and applied before first paint.

TransitionLink.note: Retired: every navigation is a document navigation here, so CSS @view-transition { navigation: auto } covers it with no script.

cssFeatures.fallback: Static per-scheme values under @supports not (…) and :root[data-theme="light"].

cssFeatures.gate: Unknown at-rule is dropped by the parser

cssFeatures.feature: Same-document view transitions (startViewTransition) + view-transition-name on project cards
cssFeatures.gate: typeof document.startViewTransition === 'function' and no reduced motion

cssFeatures.fallback: Content simply visible; reading-progress bar not rendered.
Dialogs and the menu appear without animation.
Menu popover pinned under the header; tooltip hidden (trigger keeps its own label).
Without popover support the menu stays hidden; desktop nav is unaffected and the footer lists every page.
Cards stretch to row height; footers still align via 1fr.

cssFeatures.gate: @supports selector(:has(*)) for card focus; selector-level degradation for body:has(dialog:modal)
cssFeatures.fallback: :focus-within ring; page keeps scrolling behind a dialog.

accessibility.landmarks: Layout renders skip link → header (banner) → main#main → footer (contentinfo). Pages render exactly one h1 and never their own <main>.

contrastPairs.use: Subtle text on the page surface only (dark)
Links, eyebrows, accent text at any size (dark)
Subtle text in the footer (dark surface-muted)
Error text (dark), error-500 lightened in oklch
Muted and subtle text on the page (light)
Success text (light), success-500 darkened in oklch

avoid.use: Gold as text or underline on light surfaces (1.43:1). Light mode uses ink-900 text and an ink-500 underline.
Gold text on ink-700 (4.42:1). Use gold only on sage-blue-900 or ink-900.
Subtle text on raised surfaces (4.45:1). Raised components re-point --text-subtle to --text-muted.
v1 dark input border (2.13:1). v2 uses ink-500.
Raw error-500 as text on raised dark surfaces (3.96:1). v2 lightens it to #F37F6E.
Raw success-500 as text on light (1.87:1). v2 darkens it to #0E592E.
White text on error-500 (3.82:1), the v1 destructive button. Not shipped in v2.

performance.budgets: No layout shift from fonts (size-adjusted fallbacks), hero/LCP image has priority, every image and embed reserves its aspect ratio, no render-blocking third-party CSS or script.
performance.javascript: Native platform over libraries: <dialog>, popover, CSS for motion. The only inline script is the ~140-byte theme bootstrap.

toneOfVoice.description: Speak with confidence. Use clear, declarative statements.
Respect the user's time. Be direct and to the point.
When explaining complex topics, be instructive. Use tooltips and helper text to provide context where needed.
Use correct technical terminology. Avoid ambiguity.

voice: First person, plain and specific. State what was built and its status as it is: client builds that were not launched are "built", never "live" or "production".
